units.Description: Copied from the NWB ElectricalSeries unit attribute ('volt'). Per the NWB specification, physical value = stored value x conversion attribute (see _ieeg.json NWBSignalMetadata.attributes.conversion). Nothing was rescaled; see README for the scaling caveat.

nwb_table_row.Description: Zero-based electrode table row selected by ElectricalSeries/electrodes, in signal column order.

nwb_electrode_id.Description: Original electrode table id; used as channel name only when no explicit label exists.
